Fun Service Opportunities! Green Pod Hours!

Mark your calendar for some volunteer opportunties! Email laflinh@central.edu if you are interested in serving. It will be a great time in community & making a difference in the world.

-Wednesday, 4/22: serving with Pella Food Shelf from 6-7 pm! We will leave from Gaass lot at 5:45 pm.

SECRET CHURCH: pizza, teaching by David Platt, & snacks!

Many Christians around the world cannot study God’s Word without severe persecution. Join us for Secret Church on April 17th as we study the book of Elijah, word by word & pray for believers persecuted in Nepal with teaching by David Platt over the course of 6 hours. Livestream begins at 6:00 pm & food is provided starting at 5:30pm. Dinner, snacks, livestream, & booklet are provided, just make sure to reserve your spot today! Please email laflinh@central.edu with questions. Sign up here to secure your spot: 
https://forms.gle/STimLbTZauRWWQCB6

Central College Mission Statement Central College Mission Statement

Central College is a welcoming learning community committed to vigorous and open inquiry as the best preparation for lives of integrity, creativity, and adaptability. Our students learn collaboratively with supportive educators who share a commitment to intellectual engagement, personal growth, career readiness and civic involvement.Shaped by its Christian heritage, Central College values inclusivity, humility, kindness, and hospitality, and invites learners of all backgrounds and faiths to join us in the pursuit of knowledge, opportunity, and fulfillment.

St. Mary's Catholic Church FREE shuttle bus to Sunday Mass

The Free shuttle bus to St. Mary's Catholic Church for Mass will run this Sunday 4/12/26. Pick-up will be on the west side of Central Market from 10:10 am to 10:15 am and at Independence and 3rd (4-way stop) from 10:16 am to 10:18 am. 
Pick-up times are carefully followed. Return drop-off will be at Central Market. No reservations are required. 

If you would like a weekly email with confirmation that the shuttle bus services will be provided that Sunday please email fullerj@central.edu

Trade Snow for Sun: Merida, Mexico (Jan 4 - 15, 2027)

Looking for an unforgettable way to spend Winter Break? Join our faculty-led trip to Merida, Mexico ( January 4 - 15, 2027 ), and immerse yourself in the language, culture, and everyday life of the Yucatan Peninsula. Program fee: $2,250 (includes housing, most meals, tours, transportation, and entrance fees) *Airfare not included. 
Enroll in SPAN 160/260/360/460 – Language & Culture in Yucatan (1 - 4 credits) during Fall 2026 , and travel with the class to Merida, Mexico over winter break in January 2027 for an immersive cultural and language experience. 

Interested? Contact Prof. Oscar Reynaga (reynagao@central.edu)

Life after Graduation . . . Financial Literacy 101

Life after graduation . . . Whether you are a Senior graduating this May or a Freshmen working toward May 2029, being prepared for life after college is just a good plan. 
Monday, April 13 | VSC Room 241 | 6:30pm 

Topics: 

Health & Life Insurance - Paycheck Issues - Loans -Credit Cards - Savings & Investments 

***Bring your laptop*** 

Presented by Mark Mills and Al Hibbard

Common Ground Charity Drag Show

Common Ground is hosting their annual Charity Drag Show on April 11th!! Featuring Ivy LaVoix (Central Alum), Tomi Saint James, Shae P. Shifter, and many more performers. Doors open at 7:30p. This is an 18+ event and a cash bar is available for those 21 years and older - bring tips for our charities, Iowa Trans Mutual Aid Fund and Iowa MMJ (Migrant Movement for Justice). See you in Graham Conference Center
